findings.title: Direct LLM API calls in emergency alerts bypass model router

evidence.observation: Direct invocations of call_gemini and call_mistral bypassing the central model router

proposed_action.description: Refactor emergency alert generation to route requests through the centralized model router endpoint

findings.expected_benefit: Ensures centralized logging, quota management, fallback routing, and observability for emergency alerts
findings.policy_decision_rationale: Category: router_bypass; Evidence strength: conclusive; Confidence: 0.95; Risk: medium; Automation: needs_signoff; Category reason: Router bypasses must be corrected by design review

findings.title: Model router call log missing

evidence.observation: Configured call log path does not exist on disk (call_log_exists is false)

proposed_action.description: Ensure the model router service creates and persists request logs to the designated call_log.jsonl path

findings.expected_benefit: Restores visibility into routing decisions, token usage, latency metrics, and error rates
findings.policy_decision_rationale: Category: observability_gap; Evidence strength: conclusive; Confidence: 0.90; Risk: medium; Automation: needs_signoff; Category reason: Changes to running services require verification

findings.title: Recent request failures detected in model router

evidence.observation: Model router status reports 4 recent failed requests

proposed_action.description: Investigate router failure logs and implement automatic circuit breaking or alert notifications

findings.expected_benefit: Reduces downstream request failures and identifies model backend unavailability
findings.policy_decision_rationale: Category: operational_failure; Evidence strength: strong; Confidence: 0.85; Risk: high; Automation: needs_signoff; Category reason: Operational failures need manual triage
